description: Search Ticketmaster's US events for a keyword and pull structured event records from each result.

categories.description: Limit results to these top-level categories. Empty = all.
categories.title: Category filter

dateFrom.description: Only include events on or after this date. ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no lower bound.
dateFrom.title: Earliest event date

dateTo.description: Only include events on or before this date. ISO format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: Latest event date

keyword.description: What to search for. Free-text — passed verbatim to Ticketmaster's search. Examples: artist name ("Taylor Swift"), genre ("hip hop"), city + category ("concerts new york").
keyword.title: Search keyword

maxResults.description: Hard cap on event records emitted. Ticketmaster returns ~20 events per page; the actor walks pages until the cap or until results are exhausted.
maxResults.title: Maximum results

skipCancelled.description: Drop events flagged as cancelled, postponed, or rescheduled.
skipCancelled.title: Skip cancelled / postponed

skipSoldOut.description: Drop events flagged as `soldOut: true` by Ticketmaster.
skipSoldOut.title: Skip sold-out events

title: Ticketmaster Scraper Input
